Supverify account and data deletion

To delete your Supverify account and the subscription tracking data associated with it, open the app and go to Profile → Delete account and data.

Data deleted: Firebase account, display name, sign-in email, subscription records, price history, and notification preferences stored for the account.

Deletion is permanent. Information that must be retained for security or legal reasons may be kept only for the required period, as described in the Privacy Policy.

If you cannot access the app, contact the developer support email shown on the Google Play listing and include the account email you want to delete.
